description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git functionality related to shallow clones and push operations. It defines setup functions, executes a series of tests using 'test_expect_success', and manipulates Git repositories to verify behaviors like pushing from shallow clones, handling grafted roots, and object count verification.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the given message by writing to a 'tracked' file, adding it to the index, and committing.
